tools.name: list_local_markets
tools.description: Metro and service slugs PressGEO covers, for use with get_local_market.

tools.name: get_local_market
tools.description: Recorded 90-day AI recommendation data for local firms in a metro, optionally one service. Null citation rate means unmeasured, not zero. Use list_local_markets for valid slugs.

tools.name: get_local_factsheet
tools.description: Published, owner-confirmed factsheet for a local business: services, city, service areas, sourced awards and source URLs. Owner confirmation is not independent certification.

tools.name: get_newsroom
tools.description: Public PressGEO newsroom for a company slug: company-supplied description, links and published releases. Statements are supplied by the company, not independently verified.

tools.name: get_confirmed_entity
tools.description: Read one published entity and its SHA-256 content-integrity receipt; owner confirmation is not independent verification.

tools.name: check_business_visibility
tools.description: Look up a domain in the public 90-day local index; optionally narrow metro/service. No live probes, engine breakdown or private audit data. A missing domain is not a zero score.

tools.name: get_market_leaders
tools.description: Return up to 20 measured local firms ordered by recorded 90-day citation rate in one metro/service. Samples differ; not quality rankings or proof of leads. Unmeasured firms are omitted.

tools.name: get_buyer_prompts
tools.description: Return configured city-specific monitoring question templates for a metro/service. These are PressGEO research templates, not observed user searches, search volumes, or proof a question was tested.

tools.name: find_confirmed_providers
tools.description: List businesses with published owner-confirmed PressGEO factsheets matching a service/city. Alphabetical; not a ranking or complete list.

tools.name: generate_visibility_report
tools.description: Combine a domain’s recorded appearances with the measured leaders in its metro/service and next steps. Uses existing public samples only; no live scan.
